weekend_note: Cooler and drier for the weekend: highs around 71 Saturday and 70 Sunday, lows near 60, with a slight chance of showers (20%) only today. NWS has a Wind Advisory from 10 PM Friday to 7 PM Saturday, so expect gusty conditions on the beaches and bridges early Saturday. Picks: Gallery Night downtown tonight, UWF football (1 PM Saturday) and Ice Flyers opening night (indoors at the Bay Center) on Saturday, fall baseball on Saturday, and Barktoberfest on Sunday. Escambia schools reopen Monday.

news.title: Escambia County debris pickup under way, expected to take months
news.summary: Crews began collecting storm vegetation early this week, working the north and south halves of the county. Officials expect three to four months of cleanup with several rounds, and warn against paying unlicensed yard workers.

news.title: Escambia estimates $64 million in public damage from Isaias
news.summary: The county's first assessment covers public facilities and operations, mostly debris removal, and leaves out private property. Residents with damage are asked to file a Citizen Damage Report with photos.

news.title: UWF games go on this weekend with changes
news.summary: Saturday's football game moves to a 1 PM kickoff with online tickets only and no tailgating. Volleyball is home Friday and Sunday. Campus debris work continues and the east entrance stays closed.

news.title: ECUA lifts boil-water notice for Pensacola Beach
news.summary: ECUA ended the Pensacola Beach notice Wednesday, a day after lifting it for most of the mainland, Perdido Key included.

news.title: Escambia County schools to stay closed until Monday
news.summary: The district stays closed the rest of this week for repairs, with reopening planned for Monday Oct 19.

news.title: Cleanup continues as debris, blocked roads and hazards linger
news.summary: As of Monday night about 46,000 county customers were still without power. Regular trash routes had resumed, and officials asked for patience on debris questions.

news.title: Bay Center's Southern Tip Off basketball game canceled
news.summary: The Mississippi State vs Florida State game was canceled because of Isaias; organizers are looking at rescheduling and Ticketmaster buyers are being refunded.

coverage_note: Written overnight Friday Oct 16. Coverage was thin: WebFetch could open only pages that surfaced in searches, and NorthEscambia.com blocked fetching, so no Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah or Cantonment events were added (its search titles only showed storm relief sites). The forecast is the NWS point forecast for the Gulf Breeze area issued 1:21 AM Oct 16; it lists only today's rain chance (20%), so other days show 0 meaning no rain was mentioned, and it runs 7 days (no 8th). News is from WEAR and Local Pulse articles dated Oct 12 to 15. Most event listings are carried over from earlier checks and lack organizer confirmation after the storm; no new restaurant openings or closings were confirmed, and Pelican Bar and Grill, Casa Luvia and Launch remain unconfirmed. Saenger, Ice Flyers and Blue Wahoos pages were not rechecked.
